{{Quote|What begins, ends.<br />What is born, dies.<br />All that is made can be un-made.<br />Dark has no meaning without light,<br />And for all living things<br />there is the final<br />silence.|"[[Life's Memories (Londahl)|Life's Memories]]" by Soshu Londahl|<ref name="Life's Memories (article)">{{Wizards|url=default.asp?x=starwars/livingforce/swlf20030703memories|text=Life's Memories}}</ref>}}
'''Soshu Londahl''' was an [[Ithorian/Legends|Ithorian]] author. Londahl wrote "[[Life's Memories (Londahl)|Life's Memories]]," which was published in his anthology ''[[Lyrical Metaphysics: Ode on an Odon]]'' by [[Coruscani Publishing]]. It was later quoted by [[San Herrera]] and [[Nia Reston]] in their paper also named "[[Life's Memories (Herrera and Reston)|Life's Memories]]."

==Behind the scenes==
Soshu Londahl was mentioned in [[Memoirs (article)|''Life Memories'']], an article published in 2003 as a tie-in to the [[Living Force (roleplaying campaign)|''Living Force'']] adventure ''[[Belted In: Excursion|Excursion]]''.
